purpose: Record public leads that may contain synchronized HRS-to-vehicle measurements without admitting unverified material as validation evidence.

accepted_candidate_requirements: publicly identifiable source and persistent identifier
raw or de-identified common-clock station/dispenser/receiving-vessel channels
access and reuse terms suitable for independent scoring
not_admitted_as_validation: aggregate station inventories or pass/fail tables
article claims without a reproducible data file
data whose license or channel provenance is unresolved
